### Spousal state-job candidate: bundled reform boundary — 2026-10-04

Resolve `task-8738606bf794` inspected the PKU precursor's Online AppendixI.2,
PDF57–59, appendix printed3–5. It explicitly combines the Company Law,
foreign-exchange/trade restructuring and tax restructuring as the post1993
institutionalization episode. The coastal classification reflects economic
responsiveness, not a legal list of places uniquely assigned one reform.
The paper-used DDD is recoverable, but cannot identify any one component's
effect separately. This is a substantive canonical-boundary gap: the current
repository represents an instrument under a specific implementation and
assignment, not a broad transition-era policy family. Do not manufacture a
Company-Law treatment by relabelling the paper's multi-reform comparison.

An independent official chronology was actually inspected visually in the
[CSRC1995No2 gazette](https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100024/c1492397/1492397/files/543a9663ebb241219ef78e80b5a25355.pdf),
PDF4, printed1: the March29,1995 notice `证委发〔1995〕5号` states that the
Company Law became effective July1,1994. This contradicts the precursor's
AppendixI.2 statement that all three measures became effective January1,1994.
It does not demonstrate erroneous regression coding: the observed pre/post
waves are1993/1997, not monthly1994. The gazette opening establishes the law's
date only, not the full legal provisions, the paper's spouse exposure or a
coastal assignment. NPC/court text endpoints and Zhejiang gazette were
inaccessible; no primary law body was read from those endpoints.

The survey provider's old homepage redirects to [CHNS](https://chns.cpc.unc.edu).
Its [ID Variables](https://chns.cpc.unc.edu/data/documentation/idvar/)
documentation was read in full: new identifiers replace old IDs throughout
the files; `IDind` is stable across waves, `HHID` identifies households, and
`COMMID` joins community-year information. Use `IDind × WAVE` for individual
longitudinal merges and household rosters for actual partner links; household
membership alone does not identify a spouse. The
[Special LINE Numbers](https://chns.cpc.unc.edu/data/documentation/lineno/)
page identifies newly added members, so neither a constant row order nor a
new-member code alone should stand for unchanged marriage. The
[FAQ](https://chns.cpc.unc.edu/data/faq/) explicitly withholds county/city
names and locations and offers reviewed, paid administrative-code linkages.
This does not block the paper's province-level comparison; it conditions
local-policy or county-risk extensions. The current
[study-population page](https://chns.cpc.unc.edu/about/design/study/)
lists later expanded coverage, not the seven-province baseline's weights or
national representativeness. No data files, questionnaires or final journal
replication code were inspected; do not certify exact reproduction.

Disposition: blocked at institutional-identity admission, retaining the useful
paper-specific exposure and join guidance. Reopen with an application or
institutional evidence that connects this comparison to a bounded instrument
and implementation regime; merely obtaining another abstract or a convenient
January1994 date is insufficient. Nonrandom spouses, household-only clustering
for seven provinces, differential entrepreneurial trends and attrition remain
research conditions, not proof that the original study is invalid. No canonical
record added, no existing knowledge modified or removed.

longitudinal joins and employer-sector definitions, inference with seven
provinces, partner selection and group-specific trends, and any final-version
change. The manuscript's claim that several laws all took effect January1,1994
must be checked instrument by instrument; it cannot become a verified common
effective date. Its description of CHNS as nationally representative also
requires checking survey-provider coverage, rather than generalizing a
seven-province analysis to all mainland households. Preserve this as one
candidate exposure, not separate shocks for entrepreneurship, innovation or
family insurance. No canonical file or data-repository asset was written.

### Bankruptcy-court resolution: inauguration is not universal case routing — 2026-10-04

Resolve `task-c100ed73d292` follows candidate-b5697df75a46, CER2026
DOI10.1016/j.chieco.2026.102706. New primary evidence makes the institutional

The [Shanghai High Court inauguration account](https://www.hshfy.sh.cn/shfy/gweb2017/channel_tp_view.jsp?pa=aaWQ9MjA0ODQPdcssz&zd=xwzx),
February1,2019, was inspected in full. The named bankruptcy court was
established inside the Third Intermediate People's Court, following approval
to adjust its internal institutions. It is not a new standalone people's court.
The account's broad statement of concentrated jurisdiction must be read with
the later operative rules, not used to classify every local case identically.

The [Shanghai bankruptcy jurisdiction implementation rules](https://www.hshfy.sh.cn/shfy/web/xxnr.jsp?pa=aaWQ9MjAxMjg2NTUmeGg9MSZsbWRtPWxtOTEwz)
were inspected in full, including the June4,2019 signature, May24 adoption
and Articles1-4. Their authority is the SPC approval Fa[2019]4;
Article4 makes the rules effective upon issuance. Article1 covers registered
Shanghai enterprises' party-initiated proceedings except those assigned to
the financial and railway transport courts, specified enforcement-to-bankruptcy
transfers, derivative litigation, cross-border matters and appeals. Article2
assigns enterprises registered in Minhang, Xuhui, Huangpu and Yangpu to the
railway transport court and also covers local SOEs, subject to its stated
exceptions. Article3 retains district-court handling of specified local
enforcement transfers and already-accepted compulsory-liquidation matters
that subsequently enter bankruptcy. These provisions describe differentiated
jurisdiction, not universal exposure to one adjudicating bench.

Consequently, institution availability, ex-ante creditor expectations and
actual case adjudication are different exposure concepts. A listed firm's
head-office city alone does not reconstruct registered-enterprise category,
court jurisdiction and procedural route. An annual city-availability design
can still be meaningful, but its meaning must come from the paper's encoding;
it must not be rewritten as the effect of universally receiving new-court
adjudication. February inauguration and June rules also cannot be collapsed
into a verified daily treatment date. This is an analytical encoding implication,
not evidence that the unpublished-to-us CER methods are wrong.

The Guangdong white paper's PartII, sectionII, also documents a later2019
change toward intermediate-court jurisdiction, with designated lower-court
exceptions and restrictions on routing listed/financial/group-consolidation
cases to lower courts. Its November guidance is reported there, but a
[Guangzhou court-hosted copy](https://www.gzcourt.gov.cn/ck321/ck326/2020/09/25160101333.html)
could not be read (HTTP420). Do not treat a secondary date summary as
inspection of that original instruction. Final-body/appendix searches under
the DOI and authors did not recover an open version; no messages were sent.

Finish blocked, preserving the new primary jurisdiction evidence. Reopen when
the CER full methods, court/date inventory and firm exposure joins can be
inspected. This task adds neither a canonical case nor a ready count; it closes
a real institutional ambiguity while leaving exact research assignment,
comparison cohorts and investment-outcome construction unresolved.

The paper reports county-stratified village randomization: officials nominate
five poor villages in each of ten counties in Gansu, Sichuan, Henan, Hunan and
Shandong; researchers select three for treatment and two for control. The
August2010 baseline precedes introduction from September2010, with most lending
starting January-June2011. One Hunan county begins lending only June2012 and
is excluded from the main analysis. The July2012 follow-up retrospectively
measures2011 outcomes, whereas baseline outcomes concern2009. The original
1500 households become1351 re-interviewed; the main sample is1234 households
in45 villages/nine counties. Preserve both attrition and the implementation
exclusion instead of describing the analysed sample as the original allocation.

Treatment is the village offer, not borrowing: paper-reported take-up is28%.
Committees choose lending terms; loans support income-generating activities,
typically with group liability, no collateral and one annual repayment. Equation1
is a household ITT ANCOVA with baseline outcomes/covariates and county-stratum
effects, village-clustered errors. The author also describes within-stratum
randomization inference. Migration is noncommuting work away from the specified
home administrative area for at least ten days by members aged16-65. Asset
heterogeneity is not itself randomized, nor is the exclusion of a late county.

AppendixD exposes a useful data limit: transport prices are2016 prices deflated
to2010, not observed2010/2012 tickets; across-province destinations are proxied
by the two most common destination provinces. Rent proxies rely on capital-city
rents and assumed20-square-metre per-person housing. These are mechanism-cost
proxies, not the randomized treatment. Rainfall in AppendixE is an auxiliary
instrument for assets, not a second canonical case being admitted by this screen.

Retain a china-variation candidate for development finance and rural-to-urban
resource allocation, not an agriculture-output treatment. Resolve original
experimental allocation/protocol and implementation evidence, exact village and
household identifiers, companion-paper overlap, attrition/full-sample diagnostics,
and access to the survey/replication materials before canonical admission. Do not
convert the nationwide2006 rollout into the experiment or lending take-up into
random assignment. No canonical changed; ready116.

currently marked repealed, not a current eligibility guide.

physical production and industry production functions, not revenue TFP.

cross-validation with excess mass equalling missing mass; rounding at50/100
multiples is modeled. Outside-window outcome regressions allow a cutoff jump,
sector effects and rounding. Density-weighted outcome differences recover
capital-adjusting firms' treated/counterfactual means. Capital movers are not
observed random assignment; no-adjustment smoothness and no downward response
are identifying assumptions. The trade-effect ratio additionally needs exclusion:
capital adjustment must not independently change the proposed outcome.

customer channels are not measured. SectionVD cautions that2003/2004 reforms
contaminate a permanent-treatment reading of later outcomes. These checks are
reported body descriptions; the referenced appendix results were not inspected.

M&E/HTE/SEZ/Pudong exclusions, customs-to-ASIF join and unmatched-firm handling,

exceptions make these substantive assignment/data gaps, not formatting debt.

### Migration-network final-body audit: weight normalization and cohort mismatch — 2026-10-07

Audit `task-5d5d2c249284` revisits `candidate-598eeecc4fe2` using the
[author-hosted published article](https://hanzhezhang.github.io/research/2501YoungWomenInCitiesJDE.pdf),
printed p4 footnote3, p7 Section4.2 and footnotes11-12, and p8 Section4.2
continuation. These inspected passages close several construction details.
The matrix uses origin-province rows and destination-province columns.
Off-diagonal entries count 1995 inter-provincial migrants; diagonal entries
count within-province, cross-county migrants. Every row is divided by the
total number of people from that origin province who moved across counties
in1995. Thus the weights are migration destination shares, not province
population shares or a county-pair matrix. The shock vector counts counties
first receiving a zone during1996-2000. For an origin county itself first
treated during that window, remove one from its province's shock count
before applying the weights. This is why exposures can differ between
counties in the same province.

The published p4 footnote3 reports106 zones mapping to86 counties present
in the2000 census. The earlier July2023 appendix used87 early-treated
counties; do not silently substitute that older simulation population.
The published p8 continuation adds518 shocks during2001-06 to construct
the counterfactual pool and refers to AppendixA for the draw algorithm.
The paper's identifying claim is exchangeability of earlier versus later
establishment within this pool, conditional on expected pull exposure;
neither predetermined weights nor an official directory proves that claim.
The final text does not, by itself, establish the appendix draw count,
sampling restrictions or a reconciled eligible-county roster.

Current [Zhang homepage](https://hanzhezhang.github.io/) and
[Koh homepage](https://sites.google.com/site/yumikohecon/) were inspected
as author HTML. Zhang links the same final article; Koh links its
[publisher landing](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304387824001275),
which returned403. Koh's separate Appendix link belongs to the subway
paper, not this migration paper, and was not reused. No final-aligned
supplement was recovered. Preserve the candidate as blocked until the
eligible-county construction, directory/date reconciliation and final
simulation are recoverable; this sharper methods memory adds no ready case.

The actual baseline is not a simple2001 policy DID. Its three dimensions
are water-polluting industry `POL`, upstream-province side `DOWN`, and
riverside `RIV`. For one river crossing a province boundary, A is the last
riverside county in the upstream province, B the first in the next province,
and a/b are same-province, non-riverside neighboring border counties.
`DOWN=1` for A and a even though a is not itself on the river; `RIV=1` for
A and B. The contrast is the polluting/non-polluting difference in A versus B
minus the analogous difference in a versus b. It is not a station-distance
RD, a randomly selected lax-enforcement county, or a government list
assigning permits to firms. The paper interprets this geography as exposure
to discretionary provincial enforcement and downstream spillover incentives.

Data section printed92 gives24 major rivers,232 counties,58 four-county
groups and30 two-digit manufacturing industries. The baseline2001-2008
panel has33,312 county-industry-year observations; the new-entry sample
in Table3 has17,592. Mining is excluded, and an industry is retained within
a group if present in at least one constituent county. ASIF1998-2008
supports production/firm counts;2008 missing value added is reconstructed
from VAT due using17%, which can confound activity measurement with tax
reporting. County controls come from China Regional Yearbook and highway
maps, with province GDP deflators. Food-processing inclusion is industrial,
not an agriculture-centered research question. New-firm classification,
historical county/industry joins and zero/log treatment still require exact
reconstruction, rather than assuming every missing cell is zero.

The baseline includes group-by-year and industry-by-year effects, not an
ordinary county-year rollout model. Table3 notes county-year clustered
errors; prose describes correlation more broadly, so serial/spatial
dependence needs separate assessment. Printed101-102 adds `AFTER=1` from
2001 to form a four-way interaction over1998-2008, with45,449 observations
for value added/firm counts and22,998 for entry. The post interaction is
not statistically significant for the first two outcomes in Table7; the
entry interaction is significant. Do not turn its abstract's causal framing
or baseline18.4 log-point estimate into a proven20% policy-onset effect.

The paper reports a2001 national target,2002 decomposition, later2006-2007
strengthening and decentralized enforcement. These reports need primary
verification, particularly the target-document identity, discharge versus
water-quality metrics, and the claimed cadre consequences. The2004
fee-per-firm mechanism check is a separate cross-sectional proxy, not a
measured statutory difference in county tax rates or a water-quality outcome.
Manufacturing location and provincial boundaries can select exposure;
transport access, industry trends, changing reporting and later policy
changes can also reproduce the contrast.

Retain a `china-variation` candidate for resolving the provincial river-exit
enforcement mechanism, original targets and county-group construction.
`china-water-quality-monitoring-rd` uses firm position relative to monitors,
while `china-2007-pollution-cadre-accountability-subsidy-exposure` uses

Resolve `task-517b17a00f3a` recovered the original institutional boundary.
The [SPC2013 authoritative release](https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/5867.html)
was read in full, not merely through its indexed gazette copy. 法释〔2013〕26号
was adopted November13, signed November21, posted November29 and effective
January1,2014 (preamble/ArticleXV). ArticlesII/IV cover effective judgments
with exceptions for secrets/privacy, juvenile crime, mediation and other
unsuitable cases. ArticleVIII requires technical preparation within seven
days after effectiveness; it is not the successor's seven-working-day upload
rule. ArticleXIV explicitly lets high courts determine upload schedules for
midwestern basic courts. A national effective date therefore does not prove
synchronous local implementation. ArticlesVI/VII retain many party identities
but require specified anonymization and deletion, contrary to an unrestricted
real-name-data interpretation.

The [SPC2016 authoritative release](https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/25321.html)
was also read in full. 法释〔2016〕19号, adopted July25, signed August29,
effective October1,2016, changes the document list and exceptions (III/IV),
requires publication of non-disclosure metadata with a secrecy exception (VI),
and specifies upload within seven working days after legal effectiveness
(VII). ArticlesVIII-XI alter redaction and retained identifiers; ArticleXVI
provides withdrawal/correction. These changes need their own measurement
boundary in any extended panel, not an assumption of constant disclosure
definitions after2014. The [SPC July3,2013 announcement](https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/5513.html),
read in full, concerns the Supreme Court's own decisions and interim rules;
it does not establish nationwide lower-court treatment from July2013.

Screen `task-7846496d7d69` covers one source in the existing high-quality

The manuscript's Sections2-4, Eq1-4, Table1 and Appendix A/B/C were

publisher PDF. The latter's DOI endpoint returned403. Do not confuse this
paper with the different2025 China Economic Review misallocation paper
or the previously blocked JDE2024 minimum-capital paper
`10.1016/j.jdeveco.2024.103304` (`task-24ad5bd22c28`). No dedicated
canonical business-registration pilot was found in the current ledger.

The candidate belongs to `china-variation`: it concerns businesses located
in mainland Guangdong, with manufacturing as the main analysis and retail,
wholesale and services as supporting entry outcomes. The institution is a
package of reduced registration costs and changed post-entry oversight,
not a randomized removal of one capital constraint. Section2 describes
capital subscription in place of mandatory paid-in verification; fewer
pre-registration certificates; annual reporting in place of inspection;
relaxed address requirements; and consolidated online administration.
These are paper-reported components whose local start dates, exceptions
and legal differences must be resolved before canonical admission. The
paper's footnote9 gives an apparent problematic RMB300,000 minimum for
multi-shareholder LLCs. Verify the contemporaneous Company Law instead of
adopting that amount as an official fact.

Sections2.2/3 use21 cities, beginning with Dongguan and Foshan in2012,
followed by ten other cities in2013/early2014 and the remaining nine at
national expansion inMarch2014. Figure A1 labels eight rollout months:
September/December2012, March/October/November/December2013,
January/March2014. Its map colors do not yield a reliable city-date table
from extracted text; no complete mapping is claimed. Figure A2 identifies
the twelve early cities as Foshan, Dongguan, Zhuhai, Shenzhen, Yangjiang,
Zhanjiang, Zhongshan, Huizhou, Qingyuan, Guangzhou, Meizhou and Yunfu.
Recover each implementation month from readable official documents and
the paper's actual treatment coding; announcements can precede execution
by several months. Early pilot content and implementation also differed:
Foshan/Dongguan's entry response is delayed until the national expansion.
Their exclusion is therefore a substantive regime check, not proof that
the original bundle was identical everywhere.

Eq1/Table1 use log new-entrant counts at city-two-digit-manufacturing-
industry-month, January2009-December2016. Treatment starts in the local
implementation month. The preferred specification has city-industry,
city-year, city-calendar-month and industry-month-of-sample effects,
beginning-of-sample city-industry firm-count weights, and **city-industry**
clustered errors, not city-only clustering. Table1 has54,336 observations;
log entry-rate regressions have53,709 because cells with zero lagged
incumbents have undefined rates. The reported0.245 log coefficient is not
automatically an exact24.5% change. Eq2 groups tails outside the minus12
to plus15 monthly event window and references the month before adoption.
Identification relies on no differential unobserved within-city-year
monthly shocks after the controls, not a demonstrated random pilot.
City-industry clusters do not erase concern about21 city-level assignments.

All cities eventually adopt: the full2009-2016 TWFE result does not retain
a never-treated city group afterMarch2014. Appendix B1 uses not-yet-treated
comparisons and truncation for Sun-Abraham; imputation excludes2014 onward
and drops the two early cities in2013 to estimate untreated city-year
effects. Appendix B2/Table A9 excludes post-February2014 observations,
the four pre-adoption months, early pilots, or uses distant Jiangsu/
Shandong comparisons. These checks address anticipation, spillovers and
staggered-treatment contamination with different samples; they do not
authorize treating later national adoption as a fresh untreated contrast.

The Business Registry Database covers January2009-December2016; Firm
Annual Reports cover2008-2016. Registration provides incorporation dates,
city/industry/ownership and capital; the annual reports provide financial
outcomes. The record must distinguish monthly city-industry entry from
annual firm exit/size/productivity requirements. Registry/shareholder/
personnel linkage identifiers and stable legal versus operating locations
remain to recover, not assumed available through a universal ID.
Zhuhai is included in entry but excluded from exit/size/productivity
because annual reports are mostly missing post-reform. Annual-report
filing dips in2013 during the reporting-system transition. Employment
begins only in2013. The authors' universal-registration claim does not
make financial-report outcomes universal or cure differential reporting.

Exit is initially inferred from stopping annual reports; revocations were
few in2014 and nearly ceased in2015. Rectified2017/2018 revocations supply
a robustness definition. Eq3 measures exit in year t+1 and omits2016 for
right-censoring. Missing reporting is not literal legal dissolution.
Size/productivity Eq4 compares entrants and exiting firms with incumbents,
with city-year and industry-year controls; an entrant means its first full
calendar year **after** incorporation. Incumbents face competition too,
so this is a relative cohort effect, not an untreated-incumbent effect.
Appendix B1's two nonstaggered subsamples produce uneven size/productivity
results: one finds entrants larger and entrant-productivity changes small
and insignificant; do not repeat a claim of uniform robustness.

The ESIEC2018 survey provides retrospective industry-level registration-
cost changes. `RegCost` is an above-median reduction category inferred
from this later survey, not an independently assigned pre-policy dose.
Productivity uses a structural control-function approach without early
labor information, National Tax Survey wage/markup inputs and a tax-based
intermediate-input imputation. Appendix C explicitly discusses omitted
labor, tax measurement and selection. A researcher seeking only entry
need not obtain all these productivity inputs; a researcher seeking TFP
cannot replace them with incorporation counts or capital alone.

and its treatment of earlier subcity pilots, phased components and annual
cohort coding. Registration/annual-report joins also lack an inspected
identifier/coding account. The public manuscript and three local regimes
are valuable evidence but do not close these links for the full sample.
The final publisher version and Dataverse file/code inventory were not
recovered in the screen; no absent-code claim is made. Reopen with an
inspectable treatment table/replication README and assignment code, or a
checked local implementation crosswalk reconciled with the manuscript.
Do not relax this specific gap into a generic data-access condition simply
to increase the ready count. Other collection can proceed while preserving
this candidate, source history and the legal corrections already obtained.

### Energy Economics product-level export rebate cut — 2026-10-03

Screen `task-de3e8592e34a` retains Lu, Zhang and Li, *The impact of export
VAT rebate reduction on firms' pollution emissions: Evidence from Chinese
enterprises*, Energy Economics120 (2023),106630, DOI
`10.1016/j.eneco.2023.106630`. The published20-page
[RUC-hosted paper](https://ae.ruc.edu.cn/docs/2023-05/baadc0cd801949d0ae821e1bfb12f04e.pdf)
was read in memory, including policy background, Sections3-6, Tables2-6,
and the printed appendix; no paper or restricted microdata was stored.
This is a bounded source in the existing Energy Economics firm/environment
lane, not a whole-journal audit. No DOI/title/mechanism match was found;
the product schedule is distinct from the existing2004 local fiscal
financing-share change in export VAT refunds.

The paper fixes firms' product portfolios in2006. `RebateCore` equals one
if any of their three largest products by export value is on the policy
adjustment list; `RebateFull` uses any export product; `RebateShr` weights
affected products by2006 export value, not their number. The policy starts
1July2007, but Eq4 defines `Post07` as2008 onward and Eq5 uses2007 as the
reference year. The figures' wording that2007 is before the policy does
not change the legal date:2007 is partly treated and cannot be called a
fully untreated baseline. Non-exporters and exporters without an affected
core product belong to the stated comparison; Section5.4.5 loosely calls
the controls non-exporters. Resolve should preserve this broader coding
and the paper's1:10 nearest-neighbor robustness, not silently restrict it.

The paper separately matches Customs to ASIF for export outcomes and AESPF
to ASIF for environmental outcomes, using names, institutional numbers,
addresses and contact information rather than a universal cross-source ID.
The environmental regression retains34,126 firms seen before and after,
1,725 treated and32,401 controls; Table3 uses180,481 observations.
ASIF-Customs and ASIF-AESPF pools contain75,465 and111,474 firms,
respectively, over2000-2013, not the same sample. City-clustered errors,
firm/year effects and table-listed city effects are the baseline; city-year
and industry-year effects are robustness variants. ASIF's post2011
threshold is printed as11million yuan on p6, an apparent source error to
check against official data documentation, not adopt as an official rule.
The appendix reports a balanced2005-2011 subsample and entry/exit checks;
neither proves away survival or matching selection. Table A3's industry
heterogeneity signs differ from the prose on p13, so do not inherit the
prose's uniform dirty-industry claim.

The [MOF contemporaneous explanation](https://www.mof.gov.cn/zhengwuxinxi/caizhengxinwen/200805/t20080519_26420.htm),
dated19June2007, identifies2,831 adjusted products:553 rebate removals,
2,268 reductions and10 shifts to exemption, with special grandfathered
contracts. The [Notice90 legal text and attachment-image inventory](https://policy.mofcom.gov.cn/claw/clawContent.shtml?id=13441)
specify the customs-declaration export date for implementation and three
distinct lists. The first scanned page of each of attachments1 and2 was
visually inspected: columns identify serial number, commodity code,
commodity name and the new percentage, not the rate reduction in percentage
points. Attachment1 first-page rows1-20 set rates to0; attachment2 first-page
rows1-19 set rates to5. These pages concern animal/vegetable products and
do not by themselves verify the paper's manufacturing exposure list. The
remaining schedule pages were not inspected or transcribed; no complete
machine-readable policy table is claimed.
[Notice97,10July2007, on the official tax site](https://shanghai.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfw/zcfgk/jckss/200707/t285763.html)
clarifies product codes, exclusions and contract definitions. The candidate
must therefore recover the corrected list and reconcile HS vintage/ranges,
not equate every listed exemption with a rebate reduction. The paper's
claim that pollution-targeted cuts persisted through2008-09 does not
establish persistence for the entire original package.

Resolve should ground the exact list used for the firm treatment, the
application's product-to-firm joins and the legal exceptions. The
comparison requires plausible differential trends despite deliberate
pollution/product targeting, global financial crisis exposure and concurrent
domestic regulation. The paper's US-share and tariff/exchange controls,
event studies, random-label placebos and alternative effects do not prove
exogeneity. Financial outcomes, emissions and imported abatement equipment
are actual applications; credit-access heterogeneity is not a separate
randomly assigned bank-credit shock. Admission remains for a distinct
post-screen task; this screen does not create a canonical record.

Resolve `task-f3ce2621c91a` admits the distinct product-policy exposure as
`china-2007-export-vat-rebate-product-cuts`, grounded for conditional research
matching. It separates the July2007 legal clock from the paper's2008 post
coding, Customs-ASIF export requirements from the additionally linked
AESPF-ASIF pollution requirements, and product-policy exposure from the
related2004 fiscal-financing mechanism. The official NBS27March2011
[coverage statement](https://www.stats.gov.cn/xw/tjxw/tzgg/202302/t20230227_1918602.html),
Section3, was inspected: the2011 threshold rose from5million to20million
yuan, correcting rather than propagating the paper's11million description.
Crossref title/authors/volume/article metadata match the university-hosted
published paper; April2023 is the issue month and15March is online availability.

Institutional identity and the firm's reported portfolio assignment are
recoverable without pretending to have numerical reproduction. The exact
author list/HS aggregation, complete transcribed legal schedule, exceptions
in microdata, later reversals, matching code and outcome transformations
remain explicit reproduction conditions. The record does not count every
alternative exposure or outcome as a separate variation, use a bad survey
threshold as an official rule, or convert event-study/placebo success into
an exogeneity guarantee. No original record, paper or data asset was removed.

The foreign institution actually assigns exposure to mainland Chinese
first-time applicants, so this is `global-china-variation`, not method-only.
Patent granting is endogenous; the excluded instrument is the assigned
examiner's prior approval rate, demeaned by art unit and first-action year.
The application uses **ultimate** first-application approval as treatment
but anchors export growth to the **first-action year**, not filing or final
grant. Eq2 defines symmetric growth between endpoint export values;
footnote16 describes positive exports at both endpoints. However, the
Table4 annualization and the different continuing-exporter description
on p15 require code-level resolution before that encoding is authoritative.
Art-unit clustered errors and
industry-by-application-year effects are reported.2,831 matched exporters
are the full matched population, not the baseline regression sample:
Table2 has1,156 continuing CCTS exporters and940 in the ASIE subset.

Section2 states2001-2016 patent outcomes and2000-2016 customs coverage;
ASIE2000-2013 is an extension, not mandatory for the customs-only contrast.
Pure assembly is excluded from the baseline, while ordinary and
processing-with-imports trade are retained. English-to-Chinese assignee
translation, company registration histories, address/industry validation
and customs identifiers underpin matching. Public patent data omit some
early abandoned applications, and unsuccessful pre2001 filings make
first-application status left-censored. Resolve needs examiner histories
that genuinely predate each target decision and the exact final code's

The [historical USPTO MPEP E8R9 Chapter900](https://www.uspto.gov/web/offices/pac/mpep/old/e8r9/mpep-0900.pdf),

administrative processes, **not a statutory uniform lottery**. The

instead describes CPC-based automated routing with examiner portfolios,
docket and backlog factors; it must not be backdated to the paper's sample.
The paper acknowledges specialization and examiner-shopping concerns,
reports balance and alternative-demeaning tests, and does not directly
rule out specialization. Keep those limits when interpreting its
quasi-randomness claim; an IV first stage alone does not establish exclusion.

The [USPTO PatEx documentation page](https://www.uspto.gov/ip-policy/economic-research/research-datasets/patent-examination-research-dataset-public-pair)
was inspected for public prosecution histories and release differences.
The final paper links [Mendeley replication](https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/wbvtd6ykfg/1),
but the landing page and public metadata API returned access failures in
this pass; no code, licensed customs microdata or numerical replication is
claimed inspected. This candidate is deliberately separate from domestic
innovation subsidies and IPO approval records. Resolve must preserve
selection into patenting/export survival, examiner channels other than
approval and the difference between an IV-local effect and a general ATE.

Resolve `task-f17314e5a4ce` inspected the final paper through its baseline
results, robustness discussion and data-availability statement. Table4
labels the dependent variable annualized three-year export growth, whereas
Eq2 presents the symmetric endpoint change without an explicit annualizing
factor. More importantly, footnote16 on p8 requires exports at both
endpoints, while p15 describes exporting in the first-action year and at
least once in the subsequent three years. Those descriptions do not
identify the same conditioning sample. This matters because selection on
post-treatment exporting is part of interpreting the estimated effect,
not merely a formatting or replication convenience.

During resolve, the replication landing page became accessible in the
browser: version1, published27May2025, DOI `10.17632/wbvtd6ykfg.1`, CC BY4.0,
with `code`, `data`, and `ReadMe_GLMS.pdf`. The sample-creation folder lists

the public download returned HTTP403 outside the browser and the browser
download did not complete. File names and license were inspected, but

not the outstanding measurement issue. The candidate remains blocked
rather than entering canonical. Reopen when these sample-creation scripts
or an author clarification establish the annualization, export endpoint
and survival rules, as well as the examiner-history timing used in code.
No new ready record or numerical replication is claimed.

This is the expansion plan for the collection campaign after the field-top five journals. It is a coverage design, not a claim that SSCI or any single business-school list supplies a universally valid ranking. Journal quality and field relevance are related but not identical: a strong urban journal may be more useful for this project than a higher-ranked general journal that contains no recoverable spatial assignment. The queue therefore expands by **research value and auditability**, while keeping the same evidence gate at every tier.

The purpose is to find papers that actually use a Chinese policy, institutional boundary, historical event, infrastructure exposure, or other spatial assignment in a regional/urban question. A China case study without a usable exposure is not a variation. A paper that merely says a method could be applied in China is a transferable method, not a China variation. Search results, titles, abstracts, and a journal's reputation help discovery; they do not establish the assignment.

Publication recency is a soft ordering signal. When two leads have comparable China relevance, spatial substance, evidence access, and likely variation value, prefer the newer paper and keep its publication year visible in the source/task record. Recency never rescues a paper whose assignment is only implied, and it never removes an older paper that supplies a distinct or historically important variation. The collection is a knowledge base, not a news feed: a 2008 policy can be more useful than a 2026 descriptive article.

## Tiers and order of work

The five field-top lanes remain the first completion boundary: JUE, RSUE, JRS, JoEG, and EG. Expansion does not silently declare those lanes complete. Once a bounded pass and its repeat search are recorded for a field-top lane, work can rotate into the next tier while unresolved high-value candidates continue to take priority.

| Tier | Journal lane | Why it is useful here | Primary archive | Independent recall lane | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field-top | *Journal of Urban Economics* | Core urban economics: land, housing, migration, transport, local public finance, pollution, and spatial labor markets. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-urban-economics) | Crossref ISSN inventory plus IDEAS/RePEc and subject/citation search. | In progress in `sources/fieldtop-china-regional-urban-coverage.md` |
| Field-top | *Regional Science and Urban Economics* | Core regional/urban economics and spatial policy evaluation. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/regional-science-and-urban-economics) | Crossref ISSN inventory plus IDEAS/RePEc and subject/citation search. | In progress in field-top map |
| Field-top | *Journal of Regional Science* | Regional shocks, networks, commuting, resilience, and spatial inequality. | [Wiley](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/14679787) | Crossref ISSN inventory plus IDEAS/RePEc and citation/subject search. | In progress in field-top map |
| Field-top | *Journal of Economic Geography* | Spatial organization, agglomeration, location rules, and regional development. | [Oxford Academic](https://academic.oup.com/joeg) | Crossref ISSN inventory plus IDEAS/RePEc, JEL/subject search, and citation snowball. | In progress in field-top map |
| Field-top | *Economic Geography* | Place-based institutions and regional processes where exposure or comparison is recoverable. | [Taylor & Francis](https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/recg20) | Crossref ISSN inventory plus IDEAS/RePEc, JEL/subject search, and citation snowball. | In progress in field-top map |
| Specialist-1 | *Regional Studies* | Broad, high-quality urban and regional research spanning economic, social, political, and environmental dimensions of subnational change. | [Taylor & Francis](https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/cres20) | Crossref ISSN plus publisher archive, IDEAS/RePEc, and regional-science citation search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Specialist-1 | *Urban Studies* | International urban scholarship on cities and regions; useful for housing, migration, governance, transport, and urban policy. | [SAGE](https://journals.sagepub.com/home/usj) | Crossref ISSN plus SAGE archive and urban/regional citation search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Specialist-1 | *Environment and Planning A: Economy and Space* | Spatial political economy, regional development, land, infrastructure, and place-based institutions. | [SAGE](https://journals.sagepub.com/home/epn) | Crossref ISSN plus SAGE archive and geography/economic-geography search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Specialist-1 | *Papers in Regional Science* | Official Regional Science Association outlet; theory and methods applied to urban and regional phenomena. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/papers-in-regional-science) | Crossref ISSN plus IDEAS/RePEc and regional-science citation search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Specialist-1 | *Spatial Economic Analysis* | Spatial and geographic economics, regional policy, and spatial data methods. | [Taylor & Francis](https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/rsea20) | Crossref ISSN plus publisher archive and regional-science citation search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Economics-2 | *China Economic Review* (CER) | China-focused quantitative and analytical work on institutional change, policy, and performance; regional/urban relevance must still be demonstrated paper by paper. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/china-economic-review) | Crossref ISSN plus IDEAS/RePEc and China-policy/urban search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Economics-2 | *Journal of Comparative Economics* | Institutional and policy changes in China with credible regional or local assignment. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-comparative-economics) | Crossref ISSN plus IDEAS/RePEc and institutional-comparison search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Economics-2 | *Journal of Development Economics* | Development policies, infrastructure, migration, and local institutions when the design has a real spatial margin. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-development-economics) | Crossref ISSN plus Crossref/IDEAS and development-policy citation search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Economics-2 | *World Development* | Development interventions and regional shocks; keep only papers with a decision-useful spatial assignment. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/world-development) | Crossref ISSN plus IDEAS/RePEc and development/China search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Economics-2 | *Journal of Housing Economics* | Housing, land, and urban policy experiments or boundary designs in China. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-housing-economics) | Crossref ISSN plus IDEAS/RePEc and housing-policy citation search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |
| Adjacent-economics | *Marketing Science* | Selective quantitative market and platform research only when the paper actually studies a mainland-China regional, development or firm exposure; not a substitute for the economics field-top lanes. | [INFORMS journal archive](https://pubsonline.informs.org/journal/mksc) | Institutional repositories plus IDEAS/RePEc and exact-title citation recall. | One targeted 2026 regional-development article screened on 2026-10-05; no journal-wide coverage claim or ranking assertion |
| Economics-2 | *Journal of Environmental Economics and Management* | Environmental regulation and spatial exposure when the regional/urban mechanism is central rather than incidental. | [ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/jeem) | Crossref ISSN plus IDEAS/RePEc and environmental-policy/spatial search. | Planned; first bounded sweep not yet recorded |

This order is deliberately a queue, not a promise to exhaust every journal indexed by SSCI. SSCI membership, impact metrics, and business-school lists such as UTD can change and may not measure the field value relevant to a variation library. When a journal is added, record the official archive, ISSN, index or scope evidence available on the search date, the publication-year boundary, and the independent recall source. Do not write an unverified ranking into a task or canonical record.

institutional, environmental and innovation questions; see the dated focus in

search history, not a veto on a paper used for the expanded goal. Journal

### Payroll collection: historical authority and ownership boundary — 2026-10-05

Resolve `task-fe201dd35ddb` follows `candidate-3af0a0233e27`.
The actual [Shanghai labour bureau reproduction of the original national ordinance](https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgwyxzfgwj_17255/20200617/t0035_1388254.html),
State Council Order 259, January 22, 1999, was inspected in Articles 2–3,
6, 10–11, 15 and 31. Article 6 lets provincial governments choose tax
authorities or social-insurance agencies as collectors. Registration,
assessment and information exchange remain separately specified. The
ordinance's national commencement is not a province's switch date, and
choice of collector does not itself change statutory contribution rates.

The actual [Hunan implementing rule, provincial Order 142](https://rst.hunan.gov.cn/rst/szfgz/202211/t20221110_29122291.html),
signed March 27, 2001 and effective May 1, was inspected in Articles 2,
5, 12, 21 and 38. Article 5 specifically assigns foreign-invested and
urban private enterprises' contributions to local tax departments, with
implementing arrangements to be developed jointly. Its scope is not an
unqualified all-enterprise provincial switch. The website's November 2022
publication is not the rule's onset. Articles 12 and 21 preserve information
exchange with insurance agencies rather than proving that all assessment,
registration and collection functions moved together.

The [MOFCOM-hosted 2019 revision](https://policy.mofcom.gov.cn/claw/clawContent.shtml?id=102439)
was inspected at the version header and Articles 6 and 8. It still prints
provincial collector choice and adds synchronized enterprise/insurance
registration; it cannot retrospectively supply a 1998–2000s treatment roster.
The [Fudan paper page](https://flcds.fudan.edu.cn/info/1094/3936.htm)
confirms the JDE185 publication and links an attachment, but the actual
download leads to a verification form rather than paper text. No sample,
cohort table or appendix was recovered through this route.

Analytical inference: reconstruct province-year agency changes by insurance
type, enterprise ownership and collection-versus-assessment function before
joining firm outcomes; do not code every firm from a provincial headline
date. Reconcile the paper's claimed early rollout with contemporaneous

reforms. This is an identified institutional boundary, not proof that the
authors miscoded Hunan. The candidate stays blocked until its actual cohort
construction, comparison and data joins can be inspected. No new canonical
record or ready increment follows.

Activation is a small, auditable change: add one lane with its official archive and independent index, record the date and endpoint, define broad recall terms (China, Chinese cities/provinces/prefectures/counties, land, housing, migration, transport, infrastructure, local public finance, environment, agglomeration, and historical or external shocks), and create only bounded screen tasks for retained leads. The first sweep should not be mixed with another journal, because otherwise an apparent lack of candidates cannot be attributed to a searchable boundary.

For each retained lead, the screen must answer only whether the paper actually used a Chinese or China-facing spatial exposure and whether a next evidence step is worth paying for. Resolve or ground must then close the identity, institutional boundary, assignment rule, timing, treatment/comparison, data connection, estimand, evidence limits, and principal failure conditions. If the full text or primary institutional source is inaccessible, keep the lead blocked or pending rather than replacing it with an abstract-based claim. Existing canonical records are reconciliation targets; they are never a reason to skip the paper's own evidence.

## Relationship to the data repository

`Econ Data Know-How` remains complementary. This repository records what changed, who was exposed, when and where, how a researcher can encode treatment and comparison, and what can invalidate the design. The data repository records the datasets papers actually use, acquisition or reconstruction paths, coverage, identifiers, joins, access conditions, reproducibility, and data limitations. Link by DOI when useful, but do not copy data assets into this library or turn a data search into a second variation directory.

## Completion and reopening

The overall campaign is complete only relative to a dated, auditable set of active journal lanes. Every active lane needs a primary archive sweep, an independent recall sweep, DOI/title reconciliation, durable dispositions for all high-value leads, and a repeat search with no new unreviewed high-value source. Adding a new journal, archive endpoint, or materially better independent index reopens only that lane; it does not lower the admission threshold for the others. A tier can therefore grow without turning “more journals” into pressure to publish half-understood records.

### Top-journal one-source screen — 2026-09-30

This is one recent *Review of Economic Studies* source, not an exhaustive ReStud
archive pass. DOI `10.1093/restud/rdaf066`, *Women in the Courtroom: Technology
and Justice*, appears in volume 93, issue 3 (May 2026), with the publisher giving
an online publication date of 1 August 2025. The screen is `task-8e43cf71a11c`
and candidate `candidate-e09a7cc12698`.

The published article and the authors' 37-page manuscript use the 2016 China
Court Trial Online live-broadcast rollout; this is distinct from the 2013 China
Judgments Online platform that supplies judicial documents. The manuscript
reports 6.42 million individual-party civil judgments from 2014–2018, court-area-
quarter broadcast intensity (broadcast cases / total cases), court-area and
quarter fixed effects, and a Bartik instrument using 2014 within-court area shares
and contemporaneous prefecture-area broadcast intensity excluding the focal
court. It also reports case-level broadcast selection by lower courts, so that
individual broadcast status must not be treated as random.

Supreme People's Court pages verify the China Court Trial Online launch and
nationwide connection process. They give dates/counts that do not exactly match
the author's reported 383 courts by September 2016, another 762 by January 2017,
and 3,517 by December 2017. Resolve the chronology/count boundary, paper-version
identity, implementation instructions, construction of the rollout and intensity
variables, judgment-to-broadcast joins, and the IV assumptions before admission.
The current disposition is a candidate only; neither the title nor the abstract
is the evidentiary basis for canonical publication.

### JDE green-credit resolution — 2026-10-02

Task `task-057c3712389c` follows candidate `candidate-b14409ff7659`.
The Gazette route was recovered through direct HTTP retrieval, without storing
the document. The [State Council Gazette, 2012 issue 17](http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2012/content_2163593.htm)
was inspected from the notice identifier through Article 30. It identifies
银监发〔2012〕4号 and a **29 January 2012** signature, unlike the Shanghai
reprint's 24 February signature and 23 February page metadata. Article 29 makes
effectiveness depend on publication, not the signature. The paper's February
2012 monthly post clock is a reported empirical choice; neither the signature
nor the inconsistent reprint establishes its exact publication or operational
start date. A dated CBRC announcement or equivalent primary publication record
is still needed to reconcile these clocks. The Gazette establishes customer
environmental/social-risk assessment and differential pricing (Article 11),
refusal of credit to noncompliant customers (17), and supervisory assessment
consequences (28), not a legally fixed treatment list equal to IPE penalties.

The university-hosted published article was further inspected at article pages
10-15 (PDF pages 11-16), Sections 5.2-6.2 and Tables 2-11. Together with the
previously inspected Sections 2, 3.4 and 4, this recovers the contrast and its
limits. Baseline `Punish_ft` switches on in the punishment year and remains on;
the national post indicator starts in February 2012. Footnote 23 excludes firms
punished after 2012, but does not unambiguously distinguish first punishment
from any subsequent punishment, or specify treatment of punishment within
2012 relative to February. This is a core cohort/sample-construction gap, not
permission to rewrite the baseline as a fixed pre-2012 treated group. Section
5.2.2 separately reports a fixed pre-guideline punishment-group robustness
exercise, with results in online Table A4; that table and its construction
materials were not inspected. Industry classifications and shift-share/peer
punishment IVs are additional robustness constructions, not new canonical
variations or established valid instruments.

Loan data cover 2009-2015 at one anonymous Big Five bank; firm-name joins link
them to ASIF and IPE penalties. The preferred Table 1 specification has 120,821
loan observations, not firms. `Floating` is 100 times the actual-minus-benchmark
rate divided by the benchmark; a coefficient in this variable is not the same
number of percentage points in the actual loan rate. Firm, subbranch-by-month
and maturity effects address different heterogeneity dimensions. Section 5.4
and Table 8 examine firm-year loan access, but the inspected text does not
fully recover the nonborrower risk set; an absence from this bank must not be
interpreted as absence of credit from every bank. ASIF financial outcomes and
AESPF emissions/intensity outcomes are distinct panels with outcome-specific
observation counts, not one common loan sample. ASIF's survey-threshold change
and name-based matching require explicit selection/linkage checks; detailed
annual sample windows and cleaning remain to be recovered from supplementary
materials rather than inferred from the loan window.

The main article reports event-study, matching, alternative clustering and
balanced-panel checks. Those are attributed claims where the relevant online
table/figure is unavailable. They do not prove random punishment, eliminate
unobserved enforcement shocks, or make firms without observed penalties truly
compliant. Concurrent environmental regulation and selective loan approval can
change the comparison independently of green-credit pricing. Emission levels
and intensity also differ: Section 6 reports scale reduction among small firms
and different abatement responses by size, not a universal technology upgrade.

Disposition: **blocked in the candidate layer**, with no canonical admission or
ready increment. The publisher supplement endpoint returned 403; the inspected
author research page links the paper but not a green-credit appendix. Retry when
a reviewable appendix/code or dated primary publication record is available.
Resolve the punishment cohort and loan-access risk set, reconcile policy clocks,
then retain separate loan and annual-outcome contracts. Existing knowledge is
unchanged; no paper PDF, credentials or restricted bank data were stored.

This lane adds one source from the financial-economics outlet
[*Review of Finance*](https://academic.oup.com/rof), online ISSN1467-3614,
to the expanded mainland-China firm/regional campaign. This is a bounded paper
screen, not a verified journal ranking or an exhaustive archive sweep. Official
publisher metadata and the author's accessible manuscript independently identify
Li and Ponticelli's *Going Bankrupt in China*, volume26(3), May2022, pp449-486,
[DOI10.1093/rof/rfab023](https://doi.org/10.1093/rof/rfab023), published online
August20,2021. A DOI/title check found no prior canonical/task/candidate match.

Screen task `task-867ed380f8de` inspected the author's
[February14,2022 manuscript](https://jacopoponticelli.com/papers/Ponticelli_03_GoingBankruptInChina_RF.pdf)
in memory, PDF55pages: pp1,10-12,20-22,28-29, Sections2.2,4.1.1-4.1.2,4.4.1,
equations2-3. This is not verified publisher typesetting or inspected replication.
The paper's specialized-court label includes tribunals within existing courts
and later new courts. A2019 court date is therefore not automatically the start
of local bankruptcy specialization. Within-city civil and specialized courts
handle cases concurrently; geography predicts assignment but county boundaries
do not completely determine it. Eq2 adds court and city-by-acceptance-year fixed
effects, not random case assignment. Eq3 uses the first specialization year at
city level and explicitly recognizes endogenous adoption. Its hazard model and
event study do not establish the absence of unobserved city trends.

Retain a china-variation candidate for identity resolution rather than publishing
a canonical policy name. Follow-up must choose a coherent institutional regime
and primary assignment, inspect the originalSPC guidance and jurisdiction rules,
recover court/case/firm/city joins and censoring, and separate court-conversion
from city-first-adoption estimands. Different outcome or design tables do not
automatically justify additional canonical cases. No paper files, case-level
personal details or restricted microdata were stored.

### Hydropower-network resolve — 2026-10-02

Resolve `task-131edc3f3b7a` re-inspected the final publisher PDF in memory,
article pp5–8 and appendices. Direct access initially failed with a transient
TLS error; a subsequent direct request returned200. This is not evidence of
a permanently inaccessible article. The primary
[2011 NDRC rules](https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/201104/W020190905514669845901.pdf)
were read, Articles3,5–12,20–26,32,35. They establish administrative/grid
responsibilities, selective protection/restriction, announcement obligations
and a2011-05-01 effective date. They do not establish the2007–2016 paper's
actual firm interruption schedules or hydropower weights; do not repackage
this continuous exposure as a2011 policy DID.

The decisive open construction gap is in published Eqs10–12, articlep7.
Eq10 defines consumption `C=G+Import-Export`; Eq11 divides incoming source
flows by `C+Export`, defines the diagonal as locally generated **and used**
hydropower and asserts weights sum to1. Under those written definitions,
incoming flows including retained local generation sum to `C`, implying
`sum(Dep)=C/(C+Export)` for a net exporting province, not1 [analytical
inference]. If the actual diagonal instead includes all generation, or the
code renormalizes, a different interpretation is possible. Neither was
verified. This is a reproducibility gap, not a demonstrated failure of the
paper's results. No substitute denominator was invented.

Eq12 identifies the recipient's hottest month **in the same year** using the
highest monthly mean temperature and source rainfall in `m-3:m-2`, weighted
by previous-year dependence. Its anomaly prose says a difference from the
corresponding ten-year average, while Table1 reports a standard deviation
of0.06 without an inspected scaling transformation. Source-province spatial
aggregation, year-boundary handling and code scaling remain unresolved.
Contemporaneous hottest-month selection also needs interpretation alongside
the claimed independence from demand. Eq13 has firm and industry-year effects,
not province-year effects, and is a supply-exposure regression rather than an
inspected two-stage outage effect on TFP.

The official CMA V3.0 catalog search lead identifies824 stations and registered
research access, but both mobile/desktop document routes failed on re-access;
it is not treated as inspected primary documentation here. Primary annual
dispatch tables and a public executable package were not recovered from the
publisher/author routes. Existing published appendix joins remain reported,
not reproduced. The candidate is blocked pending lawful matrix/code inspection
or a documented author clarification of weights, units and calendar. It is
not published as extracted or counted ready. Continue other development
sources without repeatedly reopening this blocker absent new evidence.

### Provincial court-management centralization / resolve — 2026-10-02

The 2026 Economic Analysis and Policy article is bibliographically confirmed
by the publisher as Ding, Yu and Yuan, *Judicial independence and
entrepreneurship: Evidence from China's judicial independence reform*,
90 (March 2026), pp. 378–404, DOI `10.1016/j.eap.2026.01.027`. Its publisher
search-indexed text reports a city-level staggered design and states that
rollout dates were assembled from Supreme People's Court yearbooks and local
court/government documents, with firm-registration and litigation data. The
publisher's full article page returns 403 to direct inspection, however, and
no author-hosted full text was located in this pass. Accordingly, those
paper-specific statements remain leads, not verified design evidence: the
city cohort roster, court tier, event-date rule, sample, and joins cannot yet
be reconciled, and the candidate `candidate-928a005bdb02` is blocked at this
paper-specific evidence boundary.

The underlying variation itself is not blocked. A full, publicly readable
2022 manuscript by Liu, Lu, Peng and Wang, *Judicial Independence, Local
Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China*, documents the
same provincial-level transfer of local-court financial and personnel control
and explicitly exploits its staggered rollout. It reports that the Supreme
People's Court selected 152 local courts as pilot sites in 2014, that
implementation subsequently expanded gradually, and that the authors
constructed court-level rollout dates from the 2013–2020 *Yearbook of Judicial
Reforms in China*, corroborating them with local-court websites and local
government fiscal-expenditure records. Its judicial-outcome design is a
court-by-six-month panel; its regional investment design aggregates outcomes
to the county-year level, with treatment timing shared within prefectures.
The manuscript itself notes that local fiscal conditions and central-local
patronage relationships could affect rollout order, so staggered timing is
not synonymous with random assignment. The central 2013 mandate and official
court reporting of the staged 2014/2015 pilot expansion support the
institutional identity and phased implementation. These sources justify a
separate grounding task for the shared reform, but do not fill the 2026
article's application-specific gaps and must not be counted as a second
shock. The 2016 specialized IP-court system, circuit courts, and bankruptcy
tribunals remain distinct institutional variations.

distances. `Code/Cleaning/Cleaning.do`, lines627–638, takes the minimum
distance by `id_3`, deriving that ID from `IN_FID + 1`.
`Code/Cleaning/Merge.do`, lines142–146, defines `prox_factory0` as
`distance_factories < 25000` OR a factory inside the county. This is not
generally equivalent to an external25km county-border buffer. The files were
re-read at these exact locators during recovery; this is source-code evidence,
not proof of which observations differ in the published sample.

Matching code excludes near controls using half the threshold and performs
common-support nearest-odds matching without replacement. Preparation joins
through county IDs and matched pairs; analysis uses the normalized1953
vulnerability instrument. These details narrow the earlier abstract-only
gap but do not settle the treatment discrepancy. A subsequent task should
reconcile the deposited sample/treatment vector with both geographic
definitions, or recover an author clarification or corrected version.
It must also inspect suitable historical institutional support before
canonical admission. Do not silently choose one definition or call the paper
erroneous without that reconciliation.

divided by its 1995 level, minus one. For prefecture p, let w_pk be 1995 SOE
employment in industry k divided by ALL local industrial employment.
The instrument is Z_p = sum_k(w_pk * g_k), equivalently the 1995 local SOE
share times the weighted average of industry shifts within its SOE sector.
The second, within-SOE-only weighting is computed too, but the Table 9
regressions use `soe_change_iv_bartik12004`, the first weighting. National
shifts include the prefecture's own employment; this is not leave-one-out.

SHARE, not percentage growth in the number of SOE workers. Table 9's
outcome is the change in the MODEL-INFERRED log gross entry term
`log_onemphi2004 - log_onemphi1995`, not observed permits or firm-entry
counts. A rise in log(1-psi) corresponds to a lower entry distortion in the
paper's model. The code applies 2SLS with and without the change in fiscal
revenue per government worker, not a staggered-adoption DID. Its supplied
log reports 277 and 232 observations and first-stage coefficients 0.6104
and 0.6416; these agree with the inspected printed Table 9. Reading an
author-supplied log is not an independently executed replication. Section
7.2 also uses this instrument for regional NSOE growth outcomes; the
authors explicitly do not extend the same IV to 2004–2008.

### Targeted JDE foreign-bank liberalization screen — 2026-10-03

This is a one-paper extension into the financial-development and trade lane, not a JDE archive sweep. Fernandes and Duanmu's *Foreign banks and firms' export dynamics: Evidence from China's banking reform* appeared in *Journal of Development Economics* 174 (2025), DOI `10.1016/j.jdeveco.2025.103474`. The openly available [46-page Exeter working paper](https://exetereconomics.github.io/RePEc/dpapers/DP2304.pdf), Sections 3–5 and its appendix, studies the 2001–2006 city-phased opening of foreign-bank renminbi business. Its empirical contrast combines city-year legal permission with the city-country-year density of foreign banks from each potential export destination; 2000–2006 customs transactions are aggregated to ordinary-exporter firm–destination–year outcomes, principally 2001–2005. The [2001 PBOC market-entry notice](https://tfs.mofcom.gov.cn/fgsjk/flfg/wz/hy/art/2001/art_1a3727189e7c4e7ba94a6088a09d397a.html) explicitly distinguishes Shanghai/Shenzhen's permission from Tianjin/Dalian's ability to apply, while the [2006 national removal](https://www.gov.cn/banshi/2006-12/11/content_466973.htm) ends geographic and client restrictions. That distinction and later cohort dates must be resolved against the paper's coding before canonical admission. Screen `task-e32c0fe2f5be` evaluates this as a China variation, not a generic WTO-accession dummy or exogenous foreign-bank entry. No exact DOI or mechanism duplicate was found in current canonical/task/candidate records; the raw article inventory alone is not a screened record.

Resolution found a material client-scope boundary. The [government's account of WTO banking commitments](https://www.gov.cn/banshi/2005-10/20/content_80208.htm) says renminbi services to Chinese enterprises would be allowed within two years of accession, while the [Shanghai financial authority](https://jrj.sh.gov.cn/JGGK193/20150713/0031-104622.html) dates its first four foreign banks' licenses for non-foreign-invested enterprise RMB corporate business to 2004. Thus a city's initial RMB-business opening, foreign-enterprise RMB business, approval to serve domestic firms, and an individual bank's actual license are not the same exposure. The working paper's broad description of four opened cities in 2001 cannot by itself prove that ordinary domestic exporters there could then borrow RMB from foreign banks. The author-linked final appendix was listed but its Google Drive file could not be inspected in this pass. Keep resolve candidate `candidate-2b8663e0eb6a` blocked pending paper coding/code or author clarification that distinguishes city permission, client category and bank license by year; do not turn foreign-bank branch density into assigned credit access. The later national removal in 2006 and Beijing's documented 2004 opening remain useful institutional anchors, not substitutes for that missing join.

### County travel-access resolve: changing permit regimes — 2026-10-07

Resolve `task-a1a9251829a1` inspects two primary institutional texts for
`candidate-6f8258f6d45b`. The [Justice Ministry administrative-law database](https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=60&Query=),
*关于外国人在我国旅行管理的规定*, October9,1982 approval header and
SectionsI-IX/XI, establishes a selected, security-screened regime. Provincial
governments consult military-region authorities and seek State Council
approval; the Public Security Ministry processes and publishes opening or
closure decisions. Tourism/exchange value, transport, reception capacity
and non-military status are conditions, not random assignment. ClassA's
29 named cities/counties require no travel permit or advance notice;
ClassB remains permit-required, normally approvable. ClassesC/D retain
additional restrictions; military sites within A/B are excluded. Foreign
ethnic-Chinese visits have a separately referenced1980 arrangement.
The HTML annex's multi-column layout was not visually verified as a
county roster and is not transcribed into treatment dates.

The [State Council's full reproduction of国办发〔1985〕90号](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/2012-08/08/content_6868.htm),
December23,1985 forwarding notice and appended November23 request,
abolishes the A/B labels but does not automatically grant every B area
unrestricted access. B areas meeting former A conditions become open
without travel permits; others remain controlled-open. Provinces and
military regions should settle changes and file them before January25,1986;
the Public Security Ministry should publish the resulting list before
February1. Subsequent applications follow the open-area procedure rather
than a B category. Website posting in2012 is not implementation timing.
These passages verify the national rule transition, not fulfillment of
every deadline or the paper's1985-1991 county cohorts.

Analytical consequence: retain the distinction between designated access,
permit-free travel and actual foreign visits. Earlier B membership cannot
be silently equated to earlier A status. Closure, military-site exclusions,
county-boundary changes and the1986 reclassification must be reconciled
against the paper's treatment measure. Open-to-foreign-travel permission
is also not, by itself, an SEZ designation or blanket foreign-investment
authorization. Original provincial approvals and published rosters would
help establish exposure, but no paper-aligned cohort inventory or methods
has yet been recovered. Keep the candidate blocked pending body/appendix,
sample/control definitions, historical county joins, concurrent reforms and
inference. This task adds primary regime evidence without publishing a
canonical or increasing ready counts.

政府合作、市场整合与城市群经济绩效——基于长三角城市经济协调会的实证检验,
China Economic Quarterly16(4):1563–1582, July2017,
DOI `10.13821/j.cnki.ceq.2017.03.13`. The actual20-page publisher PDF
returned200 at https://ccj.pku.edu.cn/Article/DownLoad?id=214765971&type=ArticleFile.
The Shanghai Academy mirror discovered by search returned404 (a one-page
error PDF), so it is not the inspected article. Printed pp1566–1577,
SectionsII–IV, Equation1, Tables1–6 and footnotes19–22 were read;
p1569 including footnote22 was visually inspected.

This application provides a recoverable historical contrast, not a new
policy merely because its outcome differs from the2025 firm study.
The paper reports15 founding cities in1997 and Taizhou台州 entry in2003.
Its indicator begins in the year AFTER joining:1997 cities from1998,
Taizhou from2004. The baseline1993–2010 panel therefore treats2010 and
later entrants as comparisons throughout. This timing explicitly closes
the older paper's baseline risk-set question; it does NOT establish an
unreported cutoff or lag convention for the2025 study.

The baseline contains131 units across25 prefecture-level cities in
Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai: all urban districts of each prefecture
are aggregated into one unit, each subordinate county/county-level city
is separate. Footnote19 says all inherit the parent city's membership
and administrative changes were adjusted, without supplying the exact
historical crosswalk. The panel has2,358 observations. Outcome is log
real GDP per worker, GDP deflated to1993 prices; controls include labor-
normalized capital, schooling proxy, employment, fiscal spending/GDP and
secondary-sector share. Annual national/provincial/city statistical
yearbooks supply data; missing observations were interpolated. Equation1
uses unit/year fixed effects. Tables label robust standard errors without
establishing city-level clustering.

Printed pp1575–1576 separately extend the sample to2014, when all sampled
areas eventually enter. Preserve that as a reported TWFE extension, not
a permanent untreated comparison. Printed p1577 uses a different
city-pair market-segmentation application:23 cities,253 pairs and eight
retail-price categories; pair exposure requires BOTH cities to belong.
It excludes Suqian and Yangzhou for unavailable price indexes. A pair
application needs its own data requirements and dependence assessment,
not a union with the131-unit productivity contract.

Analytical inference: selected founding cities, preparation before1997,
city-level assignment shared by county units, interpolated outcomes,
neighbor spillovers and heterogeneous staggered effects remain concerns.
Insignificant pretrend coefficients do not prove exogeneity. Resolve the
membership regime and original roster jointly with existing candidate
`candidate-801ba7c88ac6`; distinguish early formation from later expansion
only if institutional evidence warrants that boundary. Recover primary
1997/2003 entries, the historical131-unit crosswalk and annual join dates.
The paper exposes a specific municipal-archive lead in footnote17:
http://xzb.sh.gov.cn/node2/node4/n1021/n1024/n1123/u1ai105800.html
(not yet accessed). Retain this source for resolution; do not publish a
second council canonical or count another outcome as another ready case.

accounts rather than treating their search snippets as admission decisions.
The paper's old `xzb.sh.gov.cn` archive could not be recovered: the web

The body separates national regional planning from voluntary municipal
council cooperation, reports1992 departmental coordination and1997
renaming with Jiangsu Taizhou admitted, and refers to member expansion

CNIPA joint invention-patent GRANTS for2000–2015 are matched with the2008
second economic census and checked against enterprise addresses.

The body directs exact patent/census cleaning and matching to the journal
attachment. Preserve single2008 census coverage, historical relocation,
owner matching and grant-versus-application timing as recovery targets;
do not treat the census as annual firm histories or generic patent totals
as joint cooperation outcomes. Within-city and industry/ownership

economic and innovation characteristics; endpoint-by-year effects and

different pairs sharing a city. Few admission cohorts, selection,

name matching and address verification. A mismatch at district level or

reported pair structure links the patent number to both owner records

including reconciliation of the archival14-city narratives with the
reported15-city founding roster. Historical firm/city-code changes,

Retain this candidate with the two existing council candidates rather
than publishing another outcome as a new shock. The next useful step is
an actual council/municipal admission record or documented membership
history, not another retry of the now-recovered attachment. No canonical
record or ready increase is claimed from this resolve task.
